guidance.statement: De-merger will happen in November, waiting for written judgment, with focus on brand building and bottling capacity.
guidance.quote: The NCLT approval has come through so this is something that the de-merger will happen in November, but we are waiting for the written judgment

guidance.statement: New energy panel production and first line for cells are on track, with RERTC generation expected from sometime next year.
guidance.quote: we are on track in terms of both the panel production in terms of being ready with the first line for cells as well as the important one in terms of development of cuts so that RERTC can be generated from sometime next year.

guidance.statement: Expect the trend of connecting a million homes every month to continue and keep growing.
guidance.quote: We expect that trend to continue. In fact, if anything, keep growing with our wireless broadband offerings

analyst_concerns: Whether the new meeting location/format will continue
tone: Confident and positive regarding robust performance, quality of numbers, and expanding margins across segments.
